prompt: the question is the single user turn of the model's chat template with thinking off; the text is inserted verbatim
silencing: every neuron listed for a layer is set to zero where its activation enters that layer's MLP down-projection (mlp.down_proj), at every token of the prompt and of the answer; layers and neurons are numbered from zero as in the released weights; a job lists the sets silenced together
verdict: each stored answer line carries the group it was read as (the pattern line an archetype, the subject line a topic): a group the article shows by its name below, any other as 'other N', numbered within its text only; a line keeps its group when its group is the one the untouched model's line to the same text had, and loses it otherwise; a missing line is lost. A rerun is checked by its answers, which at the pinned revision repeat the stored ones character for character and so carry their groups

made_on.note: the stored answers were made on this hardware and software; a rerun repeats them character for character on the same, and on other hardware or software can differ in wording where the model's next word is nearly tied
made_on.loading and decoding: the weights are loaded as bfloat16 onto one GPU; each answer is decoded without special tokens and stripped of surrounding whitespace
